correctness.rationale: On a top face \(E=H\), the exact environmental derivative is \(\alpha_E I_m-\mu_EH\). Because the source's own mammal cap permits every \(I_m\) up to \(K_m=\Lambda_m/\mu_m\), uniform inward pointing is equivalent to \(H\ge\alpha_EK_m/\mu_E\). The source cap \(H=\alpha_E/\mu_E\) is therefore valid only when \(K_m\le1\). At the source Table 1 parameters, the exact state \((1,2,1,1,1)\) satisfies the published population bounds yet has \(\dot E=1/14>0\).

value.rationale: The feasible region is the domain on which the source declares the model epidemiologically and mathematically well posed and is later invoked in the global disease-free argument. The published environmental cap fails even at an exact boundary point using the article's own parameter values, while the corrected cap is obtained by a sharp if-and-only-if top-face condition. This is a structural domain correction, not a cosmetic normalization change.
